2026-09-08.title: AI Security Breach Could Have Hit Hundreds of Millions in Hours

2026-09-08.title: New Hampshire Primary Tests Democratic Establishment

2026-09-08.title: Oil Prices Climb as Saudi Arabia Reports Attacks on Civilian and Energy Infrastructure

2026-09-08.title: China's Record Graduating Class Faces AI-Driven Job Drought

2026-09-08.title: West Village Buyers Convert Rental Buildings Into Single-Family Mansions
2026-09-08.facts: There's a new kind of luxury real estate emerging in the West Village, and it's not condos or townhouses—it's entire rental apartment buildings being converted into single-family homes. 2026-09-08.title: Orlando Housing Market Defies Florida's Broader Slowdown
2026-09-08.facts: Florida's housing market is showing signs of weakness, but Orlando's telling a different story. 2026-09-08.title: Clippers Stripped of Five First-Round Picks Over Leonard Sponsorship

2026-09-09.title: Truck Driver's Death Sparks Ebola Scare in Remote Congo Village
2026-09-09.facts: A truck driver collapsed and died without warning in a remote Congolese village, and what happened next reveals just how fragile disease response systems remain in Central Africa. 2026-09-09.title: South Korea's Largest-Ever Divorce Settlement Hits $1.87 Billion

2026-09-09.title: Mystery Group Pumps $25 Million Into Midterm Races

2026-09-09.title: Texas Republicans Turn Against Big Tech Data Centers
2026-09-09.facts: Rural Republican voters in Texas are pushing back hard against the data center boom, and it's forcing GOP leaders into an awkward position just weeks before the midterms. 2026-09-09.title: Sinkhole Forces Evacuations at Malibu Properties

2026-09-09.title: Gas Prices Jump Five Pence in a Week as Middle East Conflict Escalates

2026-09-09.title: Companies Tie Promotions to AI Adoption, Sparking Fairness Debate

2026-09-09.title: British Learner Drivers Face 20-Week Wait for Road Tests

2026-09-09.title: S&P 500 Could Hit 8,000—But Wall Street's Getting Nervous
2026-09-09.facts: Three major investment banks—RBC Capital Markets, HSBC, and Barclays—are all projecting the S&P 500 could climb to around 8,000, which would be a roughly 10% gain from current levels. That's the bullish headline.

2026-09-09.title: West Village Buyers Turn Tenement Buildings Into Single-Family Mansions
2026-09-09.facts: There's a new kind of trophy home in the West Village, and it's not a townhouse—it's an entire apartment building. 2026-09-10.title: International Nuclear Watchdog Accuses Iran of Non-Compliance

2026-09-10.title: Justice Department Demands Election Records from 30 States

2026-09-10.title: Elena Rybakina Clinches World No. 1 Ranking at US Open

2026-09-10.title: Ohtani Headed to Injured List as Dodgers Call Up Top Prospect

2026-09-11.title: Hong Kong Jails Tiananmen Vigil Organizers for Up to Seven Years

2026-09-11.title: DNA From Discarded Cigarette Cracks Cold Case Murder

2026-09-11.title: Trump Administration Uses Postal Service to Challenge Mail Voting

2026-09-11.title: Inflation Data Sets Stage for High-Stakes Fed Decision
2026-09-11.facts: The inflation report that dropped this morning is about to dictate what happens to interest rates across the entire U.S. economy next week.
